gloss: to play a role; to act a part

definitions.gloss: to play a role; to act a part (in a performance)
definitions.explanation: To perform as a character in a play, film, or other dramatic work.

definitions.gloss: to play a role; to fulfill a function (figuratively)
definitions.explanation: To serve a particular function or carry out a particular duty in a situation or organization. Also used for pretending to be something one is not.

examples.japanese: {主役|しゅやく}を{演|えん}じる。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{悪役|あくやく}を{見事|みごと}に{演|えん}じた。
{初|はじ}めて{映画|えいが}で{役|やく}を{演|えん}じることになった。
examples.english: I got to play a role in a film for the first time.

examples.japanese: {重要|じゅうよう}な{役|やく}を{演|えん}じている。
{会社|かいしゃ}では{良|い}い{人|ひと}の{役|やく}を{演|えん}じている。
examples.english: At the company, I play the role of a nice person.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}はこの{問題|もんだい}で{仲介者|ちゅうかいしゃ}の{役|やく}を{演|えん}じた。
examples.english: Japan played the role of mediator in this issue.

notes:
A versatile expression used both literally (acting) and figuratively (fulfilling a function or pretending). In sense 2, it can imply either a genuine social function or a pretense — the context determines which.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {主役|しゅやく}を{演|えん}じる: to play the lead role
- {悪役|あくやく}を{演|えん}じる: to play the villain
- {重要|じゅうよう}な{役|やく}を{演|えん}じる: to play an important role
- 〜の{役|やく}を{演|えん}じる: to play the role of
- {役|やく}を{演|えん}じ{切|き}る: to play a role through to the end

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たす: to fulfill a role — more neutral, emphasizes duty and function rather than acting
- {演技|えんぎ}する: to act, to perform — focuses on the act of performing itself
- {扮|ふん}する: to disguise oneself as; to play the part of — more literary, often used for costume roles
- {役|やく}になりきる: to completely become one's character — emphasizes total immersion in a role
